article.title: 2 [Application of Chapter to drafts.
article.content: The provisions of this Chapter shall apply to any draft, as defined in section 85A, as if the draft were a cheque.]
article.html:
131A2[Application of Chapter to drafts.

Section 131A · Chapter XIV · page 27 of the Act

The provisions of this Chapter shall apply to any draft, as defined in section 85A, as if the draft were a cheque.]

2 Ins. by Act 33 of 1947, s. 2.
